tests.stimulus: Use known binary inputs, stable around rising clock edges. Begin after an asynchronous active-low reset and its release on a falling edge; subsequent nonempty states are established by the specified accepted-write history. Assert reset between edges at startup, while occupied and while full; keep write-valid and read-ready high for three reset clocks, release on a falling edge, and send fresh data.
tests.expected: Before the next rising edge, ready is one and valid is zero. No pre-reset or reset-time write is returned after recovery; fresh writes retain their specified timing and order.
tests.checker: The self-contained native-port model derives expected outputs only from input history, a pending-word queue, a separately presented output word, and returned-credit history. The monitor sends distinct DUT and expected values to a scoreboard; case-inequality mismatches produce UVM_ERROR. Required check counts and reset windows reject vacuous execution. Compare ready and valid one time unit after every rising edge, using four-state comparisons; compare data when the independent model predicts valid. Also sample one time unit after each reset assertion before the next rising edge.
